unchangedFiles.scope: Contains the Sesotho Intro registry; entire file preserved.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Ngola intended uses mme o hakanye demand ya tsona o sebedisa records tsa hao. Bapisa phepelo le ditshebediso tseo ho pholletsa le dihla.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Ngola intended uses mme o hakanye demand ya tsona o sebedisa records tsa hao. Bapisa demand ya tsona le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a fokotseha. Lebitso la provense feela ha le bolele boholo ba tank boo o bo hlokang.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha stored water runs low. Lebitso la provense feela ha le bolele boholo ba tank boo o bo hlokang.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa mme metsi a nkha hampe, a etsa letamo kapa a senya dimela, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa mme the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. Swale kana dam ya fhasi i tea u kona u ṱanganedza maḓi ayo nga vhuḓi.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha fhethu ha steep, wet kana unstable. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Ṅwalani intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa records dzaṋu. Vhambedzani na supply u mona na seasons.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Ṅwalani intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa records dzaṋu. Vhambedzani demand yayo na supply u mona na seasons.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi fhungudzea. Dzina ḽa province ḽiṱhihi a ḽi ni vhudzi tank size ine na i ṱoḓa.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi stored water runs low. Dzina ḽa province fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi tank size ine na i ṱoḓa.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Arali reuse system i tshi khou shuma nahone the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.

exactChanges.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
exactChanges.previousTarget: Tsala intended uses kutani u anganyela demand ya wona hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa supply na ku tirhisiwa ka wona hi tinguva.
exactChanges.appliedTarget: Tsala intended uses kutani u anganyela demand ya wona hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa demand ya wona na supply hi tinguva.
